message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right size. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` multiplied the amount by `percent` (0–100) without dividing by 100, so the refund was 100 times too large. It now computes `Math.round(payment.amount * percent / 100)`.

`npm test` passes, all 20 tests, including the two in `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`.
